name: Fill Template
description: Fill a message template from an object: 'Hi {{name}}, your order {{order.id}} ships {{date}}' with { name, order, date } — for a notification, an SMS, a letter or a subject line. A name the object lacks becomes empty.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= String(template ?? '').replace(new RegExp('\\\\{\\\\{\\\\s*([\\\\w.]+)\\\\s*\\\\}\\\\}', 'g'), (m, k) => { const v = k.split('.').reduce((o, q) => (o == null ? undefined : o[q]), values); return v == null ? '' : String(v); }) }}"}]
